From: Human Resources Department
To: All Staff
Subject: Mandatory Staff Meeting — Friday, July 5

Dear Colleagues,

We would like to inform all members of staff that a mandatory meeting will be held this Friday, July 5, at 10:00 AM in the main conference room (Room 204, Building B).

The purpose of this meeting is to present the company's new strategic direction for the upcoming fiscal year, as well as to introduce the newly appointed members of senior management.

Attendance is compulsory for all full-time and part-time employees. Should you be unable to attend due to exceptional circumstances, please notify your line manager in advance and contact HR to receive the meeting minutes.

Light refreshments will be provided. The meeting is expected to last approximately two hours.

Thank you for your cooperation.

Kind regards,
The Human Resources Department

options.d: To notify staff of a company closure

questions.explication: The email says 'a mandatory meeting will be held' — 'mandatory' means all staff must attend.

questions.texte: What should employees do if they cannot attend?

options.a: Send an email to all colleagues
options.b: Notify their line manager and contact HR
options.c: Watch a recording of the meeting later

texte:
Over the past decade, remote work has transformed from a rare privilege into a standard practice for millions of workers worldwide. The COVID-19 pandemic acted as a powerful catalyst, accelerating a shift that had already been slowly taking place.

According to a recent survey conducted by the International Labour Organization, approximately 34% of workers in developed countries now work remotely at least part of the time. This figure rises to over 50% in sectors such as finance, technology, and consulting.

Employers have reported mixed results. While productivity levels have remained stable or even improved for many employees, challenges related to team cohesion, communication, and mental health have also emerged. Companies are increasingly investing in digital collaboration tools and virtual team-building activities to address these issues.

For employees, remote work offers clear advantages: reduced commuting time, greater flexibility, and an improved work-life balance. However, some workers report feelings of isolation and difficulty in separating professional and personal life.

As the world adapts to this new reality, hybrid work models — combining office presence with remote work — are becoming the preferred solution for many organizations.

questions.texte: According to the article, what accelerated the shift to remote work?

options.a: The development of new communication technologies

questions.explication: The text states 'The COVID-19 pandemic acted as a powerful catalyst, accelerating a shift'.

questions.texte: What percentage of workers in developed countries work remotely at least part-time?
questions.explication: The survey found 'approximately 34% of workers in developed countries now work remotely at least part of the time'.

questions.texte: What is described as a preferred solution for many organizations?

options.a: Full-time remote work for all employees
options.c: Hybrid work models combining office and remote work
options.d: Reducing working hours to four days a week

questions.explication: The article concludes that 'hybrid work models — combining office presence with remote work — are becoming the preferred solution'.

questions.texte: Which of the following is listed as a challenge of remote work?
questions.explication: The text mentions 'challenges related to team cohesion, communication, and mental health'.

GLOBAL CORPORATION — JOB OPPORTUNITY

Position: Marketing Manager
Department: Marketing & Communications
Location: Head Office, Nairobi (with possible travel)
Contract: Full-time, permanent
Salary: Competitive, based on experience

About the Role:
Global Corporation is seeking a dynamic and experienced Marketing Manager to lead our marketing team in the development and implementation of strategic marketing campaigns. The successful candidate will report directly to the Chief Marketing Officer.

Key Responsibilities:
• Develop and execute integrated marketing strategies
• Manage a team of 8 marketing professionals
• Oversee digital marketing, content creation, and brand management
• Analyze market trends and competitor activity
• Manage the marketing budget of $500,000 per year

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or related field
• Minimum 5 years of experience in a senior marketing role
• Proven track record in campaign management
• Excellent communication and leadership skills
• Proficiency in English (written and spoken); knowledge of French is an asset

How to Apply:
Please send your CV and a cover letter to careers@globalcorp.com by July 31.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
